EVENT LABEL
Some Adobe calendar entries are hackathon roles. A hackathon entry does not establish a recruitment OA or a placement offer.

PACKAGES & ELIGIBILITY — SELECTED REPORTS
• 2025-08-25 | Indian institute of technology Bombay | SDE
  Package: 45lpa. CGPA: 7. M.Tech eligible: No.
Figures remain as entered; CTC, base and stipend are not interchangeable. Conflicting figures can reflect different roles or submissions.

WHAT WAS ASKED — ROLE-SPECIFIC ACCOUNTS
A Customer Engineering Intern account reports maximum-subarray/Kadane reasoning, project-linked SQL, JavaScript closures and scope chains, and DBMS normalization and sharding.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjY4Nw

A Product Intern account describes project and OOP discussion, followed by one DSA problem developed from an exponential recursive approach through memoization and tabulation. The reported interview lasted roughly 75 minutes. The exact problem statement is not specified.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjMyMg

A Computer Scientist-1 account covers two-sum, mirroring a binary tree, implementing a hashmap, producer/consumer concurrency, process crashes and a rail-schedule query design. This experienced-role interview should not be read as a standard campus intern OA.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MjQ

QUESTION PATTERNS IN OAHELPER
96 published non-mock question records. Types: CODING: 51, MCQ: 33, SQL: 8, PROMPT: 4.
Difficulty labels: Medium: 67, Easy: 18, Hard: 11.
82/96 records have usable topic labels.
Most frequent stored topics: Array (29), Greedy (16), Sorting (15), Dynamic Programming (14), String (12), Graph (11), Math (11), Prefix Sum (10).
A question can have several tags. These frequencies describe the uploaded corpus; they do not predict the next OA. Mock and duplicate-marked questions are excluded.

SOURCE NOTES
Compiled from OAHelper’s verified calendar, approved experiences and published question labels as of 22 September 2026. Campus labels in calendar reports can include off-campus applications; an interview author’s college is not necessarily the interview venue. Different roles, seniority levels and dates can have different processes.
